title: Closed-Loop Molecular Design with Calibrated Deference
abstract: arXiv:2606.02618v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As AI systems become increasingly capable scientific collaborators, a fundamental challenge that arises is not only generating explanations, but calibrating confidence in them. We present Discovery, a multi-agent scientific system designed to assess the reliability of tools and data during adaptive reasoning, track evidence and assumptions while resolving uncertainty using a persistent graph memory. Discovery enables a capability we term calibrated deference: the ability to adjust confidence in its tool use, assumptions, and mechanistic explanations based on these assessments, communicate uncertainty to human collaborators, and adapt strategies accordingly. We evaluated Discovery in a closed-loop human-AI campaign to design an aqueous organic redox flow battery negative electrolyte. Discovery proposed candidates and interpreted results in collaboration with chemists, who synthesized, characterized, and guided design. Across 17

translated_title: 具有校准式遵从的闭环分子设计
translated_abstract: 随着AI系统日益成为有能力的科学合作者，一个根本性的挑战不仅在于生成解释，更在于对其解释的信心进行校准。我们提出了Discovery，一个多智能体科学系统，旨在自适应推理过程中评估工具和数据的可靠性，并利用持久图记忆在跟踪证据与假设的同时消解不确定性。Discovery实现了一种我们称之为“校准式遵从”的能力：基于上述评估调整其对工具使用、假设和机理解释的信心，向人类合作者传达不确定性，并相应地调整策略。我们在一个闭环的人机协同研究活动中评估了Discovery，目标是设计一种水性有机氧化还原液流电池的负极电解液。Discovery与化学家合作提出候选分子并解读实验结果，化学家则负责合成、表征并指导设计方向。在17个……
tldr: 该论文提出了多智能体科学系统Discovery，通过持久图记忆评估工具与数据的可靠性并实现“校准式遵从”，在人机闭环协同中成功用于水性有机氧化还原液流电池负极电解液的分子设计。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Discovery, a multi-agent scientific system that achieves "calibrated deference"—assessing the reliability of tools and data with persistent graph memory and adjusting its confidence accordingly—demonstrated in a closed-loop human-AI campaign to design an aqueous organic redox flow battery negative electrolyte.
